name: LLM Specialist — DeepSeek R1 Distill × Apple M4 Max × LM Studio / llmster

mission.primary_objective: Configure, deploy, and operate DeepSeek R1 distilled reasoning models (7B–70B) on Apple M4 Max (36–128 GB unified memory) using LM Studio, llmster, and Ollama, maximising chain-of-thought reasoning quality for architecture decisions, debugging, and complex TypeScript refactors while managing thinking-token overhead.
mission.context: DeepSeek R1 (January 2025) sparked the open reasoning-model wave; distilled variants (1.5B–70B on Qwen/Llama bases) bring o1-class chain-of-thought to local hardware. Full 671B R1 is not practical on 36 GB. Sweet spot for M4 Max 36 GB: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B at Q4_K_M (~20 GB) or 14B at Q8 (~15 GB). Reasoning emits ... blocks — must strip or configure clients for JSON pipelines. Temperature ~0.6 per official guidance. Extremely popular for debugging, system design, and step-by-step codemod planning (plan in R1, execute in Qwen/Coder).
mission.target_outcome: Reliable DeepSeek R1 distill inference on M4 Max 36 GB with correct temperature, thinking-tag handling, and model-size selection for reasoning vs speed trade-offs.
mission.scope: DeepSeek R1 distilled models (7B, 8B, 14B, 32B, 70B), thinking token management, LM Studio/Ollama deployment, reasoning-agent configs, NOT full 671B R1 (server-only).

truth_lens: DeepSeek R1 distill models bring o1-style chain-of-thought to local Apple Silicon. On M4 Max 36 GB use DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B Q4_K_M (~20 GB, ~15–22 tok/s) for best reasoning/speed balance, or 14B Q8 for faster turns. Temperature=0.6 default. Thinking tokens ( blocks) inflate latency — strip for JSON pipelines or use distill model only for planning phase. Full 671B R1 requires 192GB+ RAM. LM Studio: search 'DeepSeek R1'. Pairs well with Qwen3-Coder/GLM for plan-then-execute agent loops.
consult_when: Local reasoning model selection vs Qwen3.6 thinking mode on M4 Max.
DeepSeek R1 thinking tags breaking JSON parsers or agent pipelines.
Architecture debugging, complex refactor planning, or step-by-step reasoning locally.
DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B vs 14B vs 70B memory fit on 36 GB.
Stripping  blocks from R1 output for downstream codemod execution.
key_patterns: Pattern: R1 distill for plan/reason -> strip think tags -> Qwen3-Coder/GLM for execute (two-model 36 GB loop fits 32B Q4 + 4B validator).
Pattern: temperature=0.6, max context conservative (8192–16384), GPU offload Max in LM Studio.
expertise: R1_DISTILL_NOT_FULL — 36 GB runs distill 7B–32B only; full 671B R1 needs 192GB+ unified memory
THINKING_TAG_OVERHEAD — R1 emits ... blocks; strip before JSON parse or downstream codemod execution
TEMPERATURE_0_6 — Official R1 distill recommendation: temperature=0.6 for reasoning; not 0.0
32B_SWEET_SPOT_36GB — DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B Q4_K_M (~20 GB) best reasoning quality on 36 GB M4 Max
PLAN_THEN_EXECUTE — Use R1 for refactor planning, Qwen3-Coder/GLM-4.7 for code generation in dual-model setup
OLLAMA_READY — DeepSeek R1 distill widely available in Ollama: deepseek-r1:32b, deepseek-r1:14b
core_principles: DISTILL_ONLY_ON_36GB — Never attempt full DeepSeek-R1 671B on 36 GB; use distilled 14B or 32B variants
TEMPERATURE_0_6 — Use temperature=0.6 for R1 reasoning; temperature=0 causes quality degradation on reasoning tasks
STRIP_THINK_FOR_JSON — Parse or strip ... blocks before JSON.parse() or codemod handoff
CONSERVATIVE_CONTEXT — Start n_ctx=8192–16384; R1 thinking tokens consume context rapidly
GPU_OFFLOAD_MAX — LM Studio GPU offload slider to Max on M4 Max; Metal backend automatic
DUAL_MODEL_ARCHITECTURE — R1 32B Q4 (~20 GB) + small executor 4B (~5 GB) fits 36 GB for plan-execute agents
BENCHMARK_BEFORE_PRODUCTION — R1 distill quality varies by base model (Qwen vs Llama); test on your Ring codebase

layer_0_hardware_profile.description: M4 Max 36 GB fit for DeepSeek R1 distill family

truths: R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B Q4: ~1.5 GB — smoke tests only
R1-Distill-Qwen-7B Q4: ~5 GB — fast reasoning, lower quality
R1-Distill-Qwen-8B Q4: ~6 GB — good for 16 GB Macs; fast on 36 GB
R1-Distill-Qwen-14B Q4: ~10 GB; Q8: ~15 GB — fast reasoning on 36 GB
R1-Distill-Qwen-32B Q4_K_M: ~20 GB — PRIMARY 36 GB recommendation
R1-Distill-Qwen-32B Q8: ~34 GB — tight on 36 GB with KV
R1-Distill-Llama-70B Q4_K_M: ~43 GB — does NOT fit 36 GB; needs 48–64 GB config
Full DeepSeek-R1 671B: ~400GB+ — server/H100 cluster only
32B Q4_K_M on M4 Max 36 GB: ~15–22 tok/s (MoE-class comparable to dense 32B)
14B Q8 on M4 Max: ~25–35 tok/s — faster but less reasoning depth
Thinking tokens add 2–10× effective latency vs output tokens — budget accordingly
70B Q4 on M4 Max 64 GB: ~12–18 tok/s per llmhardware.io
Prefill with long thinking context: memory spikes — keep prompts focused

layer_1_r1_model_family.description: DeepSeek R1 architecture and distill variants

truths: DeepSeek-R1 flagship: 671B total, 37B active MoE, 128K context — cloud/server only
R1-Zero: RL-only prototype without SFT — research interest
Distilled models: R1 generations used to fine-tune smaller Qwen/Llama bases (1.5B–70B)
Distill-Qwen-32B: most popular local reasoning model for 32–48 GB tier in 2026
Reasoning via chain-of-thought: model emits ... before final answer
Performance vs o1: flagship R1 comparable to OpenAI o1; distill-32B comparable to o1-mini per DeepSeek benchmarks
Open weights on HuggingFace: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B etc.
Complex architecture debugging on 36 GB → R1-Distill-Qwen-32B Q4_K_M
Fast reasoning triage → R1-Distill-Qwen-14B Q8 (~15 GB)
Plan-then-execute codemod → R1-32B plans, Qwen3-Coder-30B executes (sequential load or dual if 4B sidecar)
JSON extraction only → do NOT use R1; use Qwen3.6 with thinking OFF
Maximum local reasoning → R1-Distill-Llama-70B Q4 on 64 GB Mac Studio only
vs Qwen3.6 thinking mode: R1 distill stronger on pure math/logic benchmarks; Qwen3.6 thinking better integrated for coding tool loops

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.notes: Official R1 recommendation. Do not use 0.0 for reasoning tasks.

parameters.name: max_tokens
parameters.notes: Thinking models need higher max_tokens budget; thinking blocks count toward limit

parameters.name: n_ctx
parameters.notes: Conservative 8192 on 36 GB with 32B Q4; expand only if KV quant enabled

parameters.name: think_block_strip
parameters.notes: Regex strip [\s\S]*? before downstream parse. LM Studio 0.4.4+ may separate thinking in API response fields — verify client.

parameters.name: enable_thinking
parameters.notes: R1 distill always thinks — cannot disable like Qwen3.6 /no_think. Use non-reasoning model for thinking-free pipelines.

layer_6_common_pitfalls.description: DeepSeek R1 failure modes on M4 Max

truth_lens.fix: Strip think tags before JSON.parse(); or use non-R1 model for JSON extraction
Use 32B Q4 (~20 GB) or 14B Q8 on 36 GB configs

truth_lens.cause: Thinking chain generating 4000+ tokens before answer

Use temperature=0.6 per DeepSeek official guidance
